judgment.current_price_long: The existing evidence does not establish enough additional durable cash to satisfy the chosen return hurdles at56.28. These hurdles are judgmental; a9.6%modeledreturn is not automatically a bad investment or proof of overvaluation.
judgment.current_price_short: Not established. Even the new joint profit stress yields positive modeled price appreciation to2030. A lower December2026 planning value does not alone establish a profitable short with a matched holding period, financing costs and adverse-price path.
judgment.most_important_gap: Durable product economics after2030, not the standalone new-packaging margin. Removing all positive incremental packaging profit while retaining capital reduces target by only3.49/share atcore rate.93%ofcore operatingvalue lies after2030; the CPUgrowth/margin assumptions still need a durable competitive explanation.
judgment.useful_correction: Present the investment as a testable cash burden: at56.28,12%annual return requires90.08 by2030. Relative tocore, that is an additional3.20B of normalized2031parentcash growing3%thereafter, or7.79B at the higher rate. Explain what operating evidence could support those recurring cash flows rather than choosing a richer multiple.
judgment.limits: These are one-variable equivalents conditional on all other forecasts. They neither identify unique market expectations nor prove the required improvement is attainable. Do not add the cash equivalent and margin equivalent together; they are alternative explanations of the same gap.

primary_sources.title: Aswath Damodaran: The Adjusted Present Value Approach
primary_sources.supports: APV values unlevered operating cash using an unlevered cost of equity, then separately incorporates borrowing benefits and costs. Current model's operating-cash/debt/shield separation follows that structure.
primary_sources.qualification: This establishes the framework, not that Intel's selected beta, ERP, tax-shield discount rate or credit realization is correct. The model uses the operating rate on shields, not a debt-rate mechanical maximization. Future funding access and distress costs are not proven away by the APV identity.

primary_sources.title: Aswath Damodaran: The Fundamental Determinants of Growth
primary_sources.supports: Growth depends on reinvestment and returns on new investment. Economic capital comparisons should consistently account for R&D and operating leases. High excess returns lasting indefinitely require a durable competitive explanation.
primary_sources.qualification: The model's23.1%terminal ratio is3%times unadjusted-modelNOPAT divided by modeled physicalnetinvestment plusWC. R&D remains expensed in segment margins; no capitalized research asset is modeled. Call it an implied return on modeled netinvestment, not an empirically observed economicROIC. Equating this ratio to the discount rate is a sensitivity convention, not proof that all economic rents disappear.

accounting_review.cash_and_debt: Existing cash, ordinary debt, net other claims, escrow and acquisition costs included once. Incremental2027-30aftertaxcash is retained in2030cash; no incrementalinterestwindfall orfreefinancingvalue is added.
accounting_review.finite_credits: Finite collection schedules remain cash flows; normalized parentcash removes credits and related basis-tax effect. The reverse cash burden is additional normalizedcash, not additional government aid.
accounting_review.operating_profit_ablations: Foundry existingbreakevenstress and zero-positivepackagingprofit are jointly recomputed. The full124.5B2027-30physicalcapex, all later investment and2027packagingstartup loss remain. Sales remain, so this is a zero-margin stress rather than closure/removal of the packaging business.
accounting_review.cash_validation_boundary: Annual cash is recomputed. No new quarterly or daily trough, credit access or financialdistress probability is established.
accounting_review.terminal_label_repair: With consistent cash-tax handling, recategorizing R&D changes adjusted profit and investment together and need not change freecashflow. Its absence therefore calls for a better ROI label, not an unsupported valuation uplift.

deck_ready_language.primary: The price requires lasting cash improvement. A12%annual return from56.28 needs90.08 in2030. Keeping the rest of the model fixed, that requires an extra3.2B of2031normalizedparentcash growing3%thereafter; at the higher discount rate,7.8B. These are decision thresholds, not forecasts.
deck_ready_language.profit_stress: If Foundry reaches onlybreakeven and newpackaging earns no positive profit, while all investment remains, the target falls to71.84/core or63.97/higher-rate:6.1%or3.1%annually. This still assumes the product business delivers our forecast and factories recover from present losses.
deck_ready_language.durability: A phased CPUmargin improvement from44.1%to48.5%by2030 would close the12%returngap atcore rate if no extra investment is required and the gain persists. Nearly89%of the addedexitvalue comes from cash after2030. Atemporarypricing spike is insufficient.

R_and_D_scope_review.assembly: old_rows inherits EBIT_after_economic_SBC_B and computes Other_profit_less_corporate as a residual after product,Foundry andpackaging profits; build_case recombines these segment profits. No R&D addback or capitalized research asset exists in the cash closure.
R_and_D_scope_review.host_policy: intel_server_ASP_mix_operating_policy.json explicitly says incremental consolidated profit is after direct input,production,operating costs and D&A; preserves corporate costs. Forward CPUmargin derives from product segment operatingincome, rather than a before-R&Dgrossprofit measure.
R_and_D_scope_review.packaging_policy: external_packaging_operating_policy_2026_11_04.json explicitly charges ongoingpackageR&D in program operatingmargins and retains sharedprocessR&D in hostcosts.
R_and_D_scope_review.scope_limit: This verifies intended expense treatment and lack of an R&D addback, not adequacy of every future R&D dollar. The forward model lacks a separately identified R&D dollar forecast; no full capitalization or economicROIC bridge can be claimed.
